question:

ripe – पका हुआ – Fully developed and ready to be eaten or used.
Example: The mangoes are ripe and sweet.

Example: She made every endeavour to complete the project on time.

Disciple – शिष्य – A follower or student of a teacher, leader, or philosophy.
Example: He was a devoted disciple of the famous philosopher.

Parole – पैरोल – The temporary release of a prisoner before the end of their sentence.
Example: The convict was granted parole after serving half his term.

Incorrect Word: Hegimony (should be Hegemony).
